jobs.description:
Strategic Research is a central function at Alleima supporting all product areas through long-term research and innovation. With decades of metallurgical expertise and a commitment to innovation, we are seeking a passionate and forward-thinking R&D Specialist to join our New Alloys team. Together, we combine deep metallurgical knowledge with advanced research methods to develop the next generation of stainless-steel materials.  We run projects from a lean product development standpoint, focusing on knowledge building. After reaching proof of concept, the projects are handed over to product development for a large-scale ramp-up.
Are you passionate about materials research and development and eager to contribute to the next generation of advanced stainless-steel materials? You might be the person we are looking for. Apply today!
Placement: Sandviken
Your Role
As an R&D Specialist in the New Alloys team you will be part of a group with deep knowledge from several different technical areas important for successful alloy development such as advanced material characterization, thermodynamic modelling, corrosion science, powder metallurgy, and hot working. The strength of the team lies in combining our skills, sharing knowledge, and working together in an open and collaborative atmosphere. 
Your task is to participate in, lead, and identify alloy development projects, knowledge-building pre-studies, or other investigations in line with Alleima’s strategic research plan. You deliver results according to agreements and present your research in an accurate and structured manner through e.g. internal technical reports, project meetings, and steering group meetings. You will be an important contact person for material development and represent Alleima in external research projects in collaboration with institutions and universities. 
Since our projects and assignments are based on technical requirements from both external customers and our internal organization, an important part of the role is to collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, and build strong, long-term relationships.
About you
We are looking for someone with a Master of Science (MSc.) degree or a PhD in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Technical Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, combined with several years of industrial research experience within the stainless-steel industry, preferably in product or process development of high-alloy stainless steels or nickel-based alloys. Previous project management experience, particularly in alloy development, is advantageous.
You bring in-depth expertise in one or more areas relevant to alloy development. This may include production processes, such as casting or hot-working and their limitations and possibilities related to alloy development, product requirements and knowledge such as high-temperature corrosion, wet corrosion or mechanical properties related to stainless steel materials in demanding environments. 
You are familiar with common characterization techniques used in materials development, such as LOM and SEM, and have a solid understanding of the relationship between microstructure and material properties
We value your passion and personality characterized by your analytical and problem-solving mindset. As a person, you are structured, thorough, and driven, with the ability to identify opportunities, critically evaluate results, and see projects through to completion. In a determined and independent manner, you plan and drive the work forward but are flexible when the situation requires it. Your communicative and collaborative manner allows you to easily share your competencies and results with the rest of the team. All in all, you are a person who can do both hands-on technical work and move projects forward in a pedagogical and inclusive way. You have excellent communication skills, both verbally and in writing, preferably in both Swedish and English as we operate in an international environment.  
What you can expect from us
At Alleima, you will be part of a global organization where collaboration, curiosity and continuous development are at the heart of what we do. We believe that diverse perspectives and an inclusive workplace help us make better decisions, create new opportunities and grow together.
Our values guide us in everything we do: We Care, We Deliver and We Evolve. Together, we take responsibility, challenge ourselves to improve and support each other in making a difference.

At Alleima, our mission is much more than delivering high-quality products, technology, and processes - working together to develop solutions based on our customer's needs and thus achieve our business goals, is a better way to describe our daily work. With curious employees and safety as our priority, we create a work environment where you can develop both personally and professionally.
With a clear direction for our journey ahead, utilizing our position as a technology leader, progressive customer partner, and sustainability driver, we aim to become an even stronger company in our industry.

What we do at Blykalla
Blykalla is a Swedish deep-tech company at the forefront of the nuclear industry, pioneering the development of small modular reactors that provide clean, safe, and reliable energy. Thanks to lead-cooling, we achieve high safety in a very compact format, allowing for a simple and cost-effective design that can be mass-produced. Our unique reactor design will provide safe and green baseload energy that perfectly complements solar and wind power.

What you’ll get to do
We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer with deep expertise in ABB 800xA DCS to lead the development of Blykalla's plant control system architecture and implementation strategy.
This is a unique opportunity to help define the control philosophy of a first-of-a-kind advanced nuclear reactor. You will play a key role in ensuring that Blykalla develops and retains ownership of critical control system intellectual property while working closely with ABB and other suppliers.

Key Responsibilities
DCS Architecture & Ownership
Lead the design and development of Blykalla's plant-wide automation and control system architecture.
Define the ABB 800xA system architecture for reactor, balance-of-plant, auxiliary, and test facility applications.
Develop internal engineering standards, libraries, templates, and control strategies to maximize in-house ownership of intellectual property.
Establish long-term governance for control system design, lifecycle management, cybersecurity, and configuration control.

Control System Engineering
Develop functional specifications, control narratives, cause-and-effect matrices, and automation philosophies.
Design and implement control logic, sequences, interlocks, alarms, and operator interfaces.
Configure ABB 800xA applications, controllers, engineering environments, and HMI systems.
Define communication architectures including OPC UA, IEC 61850, Modbus, Profibus/Profinet, Ethernet/IP, and other industrial protocols.
Develop and maintain simulation and testing environments for control system validation.

Nuclear Plant Integration
Support the integration of reactor systems, safety systems, and balance-of-plant equipment into the overall control architecture.
Work closely with reactor, thermal-hydraulic, electrical, mechanical, and safety engineers to define system requirements.
Contribute to licensing and regulatory documentation related to instrumentation and control systems.
Support development of digital I&C architectures aligned with nuclear industry expectations and international standards.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management
Act as the primary technical interface with ABB regarding 800xA architecture, licensing, engineering tools, and implementation support.
Ensure that Blykalla retains ownership of application software, engineering databases, configuration standards, and control strategies.
Manage external engineering partners and system integrators where required.
Participate in factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), commissioning, and startup activities.

Verification & Validation
Develop testing methodologies for control logic verification and system validation.
Lead integration testing and commissioning activities.
Support development of digital twins and operator training simulators.
Ensure traceability from requirements through implementation and testing.

Who you’ll get to work with
The Senior Control Systems Engineer sits in the Plant engineering Team within Blykalla. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla. 
Who you are
You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help in order for you to succeed in this role, these are:
MSc or BSc in Control Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, or related discipline.
Minimum 10 years of experience in industrial automation and control systems engineering.
Extensive hands-on experience with ABB 800xA DCS engineering, configuration, commissioning, and lifecycle management.
Proven experience designing and implementing large-scale DCS architectures.
Experience developing control strategies for complex industrial facilities.
Strong understanding of industrial networks, field instrumentation, and process control.
Fluent in English, spoken and written
Fluency in Swedish is a plus

Technical Skills
Expert-level knowledge of ABB 800xA:
AC 800M controllers
Control Builder
Aspect Objects
System 800xA Engineering
Operator Workplace
Alarm Management
Batch and Advanced Process Control (desirable)
Strong understanding of:
ISA-88
ISA-95
IEC 61511
IEC 61508
Industrial cybersecurity principles
Configuration management and software lifecycle practices
Experience with simulation and testing environments.

Location 
This position is for our office in Stockholm.

Reference & Background Checks
As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates. We may also conduct reference checks to gain a well-rounded understanding of your professional experience, performance, and ways of working. This includes both references provided by you and, where relevant, conversations with other professional contacts who have worked closely with you. We strive to be transparent about our reference-checking process and handle all personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. Any additional references will be sought with professional judgment and only when considered relevant to the role.
We offer competitive compensation aligned with our internal salary framework and growth potential in the role.
We do not accept applications via email. 
We are not open to external help from recruitment agencies.
 
Note on AI Use: Blykalla may use AI technology to assist with certain administrative aspects of the hiring process, such as note-taking, interview documentation, and reporting. However, every resume and application is reviewed directly by our recruiting team. AI tools are used solely for operational support and do not influence candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.

Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
As Social Producer, you’ll take ownership of social and creator-led productions from brief to final delivery. You’ll turn creative ideas into clear, effective production plans and bring together the right creators, talent, production partners and suppliers to make them happen. 
Working across both fastmoving social content and larger campaign activations, you’ll create flexible production set-ups that allow ideas to come to life at speed without compromising quality or creative intent. You’ll be an important link between creative development and execution, helping ensure our content is relevant for the platform, audience and brand. 
Key responsibilities include 
Lead end-to-end production of social-first and creator-led content, from brief and planning to final asset delivery. 
Translate creative concepts into clear and actionable production plans while protecting the original creative vision. 
Source, negotiate with, contract and manage creators, talent, production partners and other external suppliers. 
Plan and book productions, managing budgets, timelines, contracts, resources and deliverables. 
Manage both smaller, agile creator-led productions and larger social campaign activations. 
Partner closely with creative teams to anticipate production needs and enable strong creative decision-making. 
Ensure content and assets are produced with relevant social platforms, formats and requirements in mind. 
Build flexible and scalable production approaches that support both planned and reactive content creation. 
Continuously identify new partners, production models and ways of working that improve efficiency, speed and relevance. 
Proactively identify and solve production challenges while maintaining a smooth process for everyone involved. 

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH 
You’ll work closely with creatives and other colleagues across social and creator marketing, turning creative concepts into high-quality content and executions. You’ll also collaborate with creators, talent, agencies, production partners and suppliers, acting as a key connection between creative ambition and production delivery.  
This is a collaborative role where you’ll need to build strong relationships while feeling confident taking ownership and moving productions forward independently. 
WHO YOU ARE 
You’re an experienced producer who knows how to bring creative ideas to life. You combine strong production expertise with an understanding of social content, creators and the realities of producing content for fast-moving digital channels. 
You don’t need every answer from day one. What matters is that you have strong production judgement, understand what a creative idea needs to succeed and know how to find the right people and solutions to make it happen.  
We are looking for people with… 
Strong experience in content production, with relevant experience producing social-first, digital or creator-led content. 
Proven experience independently managing productions from brief through to final delivery. 
Experience working directly with creators, talent, production partners and suppliers. 
Experience with sourcing, negotiation, contracting, budgets, timelines and production planning. 
An understanding of social platforms and how production requirements can differ across channels such as TikTok and Instagram. 
The ability to translate creative concepts into practical production plans without losing the creative intent. 
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills. 
An understanding of how to balance creative ambition, commercial considerations, quality, speed and efficiency. 

 And people who are… 
Independent and comfortable taking ownership from start to finish. 
Highly organized, solution-oriented and able to manage several moving parts at once. 
Curious about social media, creator culture and evolving ways of producing content. 
Collaborative and strong at building relationships across creative and commercial teams. 
Flexible and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where not everything is defined from the start. 
Confident challenging established ways of working and exploring new production models. 
Equipped with strong creative judgement and an eye for culturally and socially relevant content. 

WHO WE ARE 
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group, you’ll be part of an international and collaborative environment where your ideas and perspectives matter. Alongside opportunities to learn, develop and build your career across H&M Group, we offer a range of benefits. 
Your H&M Group benefits include: 
Employee discount: As an H&M Group employee, you receive an employee discount across eligible H&M Group brands, in stores and online where applicable. Brands include H&M, H&M HOME, H&M Move, COS, Monki, Weekday, & Other Stories and ARKET.

JOIN US 
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. 
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

jobs.description:
Are you an experienced payment sales professional ready to combine commercial leadership with closing strategic deals yourself? Dintero is looking for a Head of Enterprise & Platforms Nordics to bring together its Nordic enterprise sales efforts, develop the team and drive growth across some of the company’s most important customer segments.
About the job
This is a direct recruitment, which means that the recruitment process takes place through Bravura and you are employed directly by Dintero.
About the company
Dintero is a fast-growing Norwegian fintech company challenging traditional payment providers with a modern, fully integrated payment platform. The company is one of few players in the Nordics covering the entire payment value chain and is licensed to process Visa and Mastercard transactions directly, making Dintero Norway’s first new acquirer in more than 20 years.
The offering covers online and in-store payments, Unified Commerce and payment solutions for platforms and marketplaces. With enterprise customers such as Vy and regulatory approval to offer payment services across the EEA, Dintero is positioned for further expansion across the Nordics and Europe. In 2025, the company onboarded more than 2,100 new businesses, increased payment volume by over 150% and revenue by 200%, while reaching profitability in Q4.
You will join a growing Nordic organisation with short decision paths and a high degree of ownership. There are established structures and processes, but these evolve as the business grows. Leaders are expected to identify what can be improved and actively contribute to developing how the organisation works.
Tasks and responsibilities
As Head of Enterprise & Platforms Nordics, you will have commercial responsibility for developing Dintero’s enterprise and platform sales across Sweden, Norway and Denmark. A key part of the role is to bring the three markets together and establish a common Nordic approach to sales, pipeline management and commercial priorities.
This is a player-coach role, particularly during the first year. Alongside leading and developing the team, you will personally work with Dintero’s most strategic customers and drive complex enterprise opportunities from initial dialogue to signed agreement. You will work with senior and C-level decision-makers and navigate longer sales cycles involving both commercial and technical stakeholders.
You will also develop the existing sales team and play an active role in recruiting and building the team further across the Nordics, with the ambition to hire 3–5 additional salespeople during the first 12 months. As the organisation expands, the role will gradually shift towards more leadership and commercial strategy, while maintaining a strong connection to customers and the market.
You will work closely with the CEO, product and technical teams to develop Dintero’s enterprise offering. You are not expected to be a technical specialist, but you need to understand complex payment solutions and be comfortable discussing areas such as APIs, integrations and platform architecture.
Your main responsibilities include:

Lead and develop Enterprise & Platforms sales across the Nordics

Personally drive and close strategic enterprise and platform deals

Coach and develop the existing sales team and recruit additional salespeople

Develop structure around pipeline, sales methodology, CRM and forecasting

Collaborate with leadership, product and technical teams to develop the enterprise offering

Education, experience and personal characteristics
Several years of experience within the payments industry

Proven experience closing complex, high-value enterprise deals in the Nordic market

Previous leadership experience, including people responsibility, coaching, developing and recruiting salespeople

Experience selling both in-store terminal solutions and online/e-commerce payments

Commercial and technical understanding of areas such as APIs and integrations and platform architecture

Existing network within Nordic enterprise retail

Fluent English and at least one Scandinavian language: Swedish, Norwegian or Danish

Experience selling through and building partnerships with e-commerce platforms and integration partners is meritorious

An existing network across marketplace or platform verticals is meritorious

To succeed in the role, you take ownership and are comfortable creating structure while remaining close to sales. As a leader, you coach and give experienced salespeople ownership of their deals while setting clear expectations around execution and results.
You are comfortable in an environment where processes evolve as the company grows. Rather than simply working within an existing structure, you identify what could work better and take initiative to change it. You are also curious and able to quickly understand complex technical and commercial topics, even when you do not have all the answers from the start.
Other information
Start: Upon agreement  Location: Stockholm, Oslo or Copenhagen. If based outside Oslo, regular travel to the Oslo office is expected.  Salary: Upon agreement

#Specialist

Ovako is one of Europe’s leading manufacturers of advanced engineering steel and has supplied steel for critical industrial applications for nearly 500 years. The company is now making a strategic investment in the defence industry and is looking for someone who wants to play a key role in establishing and developing Ovako’s position in one of Europe’s fastest-growing segments.
At Ovako, you will have the opportunity to combine business development, an understanding of the defence industry and relationship building in a role offering substantial autonomy, high visibility and the opportunity to shape the direction of an entirely new initiative. You will join a stable industrial company with a long-term perspective, Nordic production, strong ownership and a clear ambition to grow within the defence segment.
The location is flexible, although we would ideally like you to be based at our sales office in Karlskoga. You may also be based at one of our major production sites in Hofors, Smedjebacken, Boxholm or Hällefors, or at our office in Örebro.
In the role of Sales Manager Security and Defense, you will be responsible for establishing, developing and strengthening Ovako’s business within the defence industry. This is a newly created role designed to develop Ovako’s long-term position throughout the defence supply chain, from OEMs and systems suppliers to subcontractors and other key players in the segment.
At the heart of the role is identifying business opportunities at an early stage, building relationships with the right decision-makers and creating a strong pipeline of future defence business. You will take a strategic approach to mapping the market, projects, decision-making processes and material requirements, while moving commercial discussions forward through customer meetings, quotations, negotiations and long-term relationship development.
To succeed, you need to be comfortable with long sales cycles. You understand how the defence industry operates, know where decisions are made and can build trust with technical specialists, procurement professionals and business leaders alike. The role requires a high degree of independence, and you will be expected to set your own agenda, take the initiative and drive business forward, even when results may take time to materialise.
You will represent the full Ovako Group offering and work closely with the sales organisation, business units, production and R&D to translate customer needs into long-term business opportunities.
We are looking for someone with an established network within the defence industry and existing relationships with relevant players, such as OEMs, systems suppliers, subcontractors or companies in related defence industries. You have experience in sales, business development, procurement or engineering within the defence sector and are accustomed to navigating complex business environments where sales cycles are often long and involve multiple stakeholders.
Experience in the steel industry is an advantage, but what matters most is your understanding of the defence segment, its decision-making processes and how to build long-term business through trust and relationships. Experience in steel, component manufacturing, materials engineering or the manufacturing industry is desirable but not essential.
As a person, you are commercially driven, persistent and proactive. You thrive in a role where you can establish structures, identify opportunities and move activities forward on your own initiative. At the same time, you bring a strategic perspective and the ability to understand the connections between different players throughout the defence supply chain. You naturally build trust, work in a structured way and are motivated by developing business that creates lasting value.
A good command of Swedish and English, together with a category B driving licence, is essential for the role. Ideally, you hold a university qualification in a relevant field or another post-secondary qualification. Travel is part of the role. The location is flexible, although we would ideally like you to be based in central Sweden or be able to visit one of Ovako’s sites regularly.
You will be offered a unique opportunity to help build Ovako’s defence industry initiative from the ground up. The role has strong support from management and Group management and gives you the opportunity to make your mark on a business area of major strategic importance to the company.
Ovako combines the resources of a large industrial company with a culture where individuals make a difference. You will have autonomy and responsibility, strong support from colleagues and the opportunity to influence both the development of the business and your own professional growth. You will join a global organisation with strong industrial owners, Nordic production and a long tradition of innovation, quality and sustainability.
We welcome your application today. Applications are reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis. Please submit your application below, as we do not accept applications through any other channel. If you would like to learn more about the role, please contact Made for Sales.
About Ovako
Ovako is a leading European manufacturer of engineering steel for customers in sectors including industry, energy, mining and automotive, as well as defence-related applications. The company has approximately 2,500 employees, annual revenue of approximately EUR 1 billion and production facilities in Sweden and Finland. Drawing on extensive industrial experience, strong materials expertise and a clear focus on sustainability, Ovako develops advanced steel solutions for some of the world’s most demanding applications. The company is part of the Nippon Steel Group through Sanyo Special Steel and has a long-term industrial owner with a strong focus on innovation and future growth.

About us
Danieli Morgårdshammar AB is part of the international Danieli Group and has been serving the Nordic metals industry for more than 170 years. Based in Smedjebacken, Sweden, we support steel, aluminum and other metal producers throughout Scandinavia with engineering services, spare parts, technical support and long-term partnership solutions.

We operate in an industry where trust, competence and personal relationships are often more important than presentations, marketing materials or corporate references. Our success is built on credibility and on being recognized as a reliable partner by the people who operate and maintain production facilities every day.
 
Responsibilities
We are looking for an experienced industry professional who already understands the reality of steel mills, rolling mills and metal processing plants.
This is not a typical sales position, more a business developer position.
The ideal candidate is someone who has worked directly within the metals industry or closely alongside plant personnel and understands how industrial decisions are truly made. Candidates coming directly from steel, aluminum or other metals production facilities are particularly encouraged to apply.
The primary focus of this role is the development of Danieli aftermarket and service business.
Activities include the sales, coordination, and follow-up of the following services and solutions for your designated customers:
Spare Parts Supply
Technical Services
On-site Assistance
Maintenance Support
Roll Shop Solutions
Equipment Refurbishments
Small and Medium Revamping Projects
Plant Modernizations and Upgrades
Engineering and Technical Consulting

Success in this role requires the ability to understand customers' operational challenges and identify opportunities where Danieli's technical expertise and service capabilities can create measurable value.
Technical Requirements
We are particularly interested in candidates who have:
Previous experience in the steel, aluminum or metals industry.
Direct experience working in or closely with production plants, rolling mills, maintenance organizations or technical departments.
Existing professional relationships within the Nordic metals industry.
A strong understanding of industrial operations, maintenance and production environments.
Experience interacting with: Roll Shop Managers; Production Managers; Maintenance Managers; Foremen and Supervisors; Category Managers; Purchasing Departments; Technical Specialists.

More than technical qualifications, we are looking for someone who understands plant culture, speaks the language of industrial operations and can quickly establish credibility with the people who influence purchasing decisions.
Fluent English, written and spoken, mother language Swedish.
Willingness to travel throughout the Nordic countries.
Valid driving license.
Experience with CRM systems (but not as a primary focus)
Technical education or equivalent industry experience is considered an advantage.

Soft Skills
For this position, interpersonal capabilities are just as important as technical knowledge.
The successful candidate will:
Build trust naturally and quickly.
Be highly relationship-driven and people-oriented.
Communicate confidently with personnel at all organizational levels.
Be proactive, decisive and commercially minded.
Feel comfortable opening doors and creating opportunities from scratch.
Demonstrate strong ownership and initiative.
Possess the credibility and character required to earn customers' confidence over time.
Be capable of transforming an initial contact into a long-term business partnership.

In the Nordic business culture, trust is often the primary factor behind purchasing decisions. We therefore place exceptional importance on integrity, credibility and relationship-building skills.
Other
Danieli - Morgårdshammar and the Danieli Group are already well known throughout the Nordic metals industry. Significant efforts have been made in recent years to increase our presence within production facilities, establish direct contacts with key stakeholders and strengthen our reputation across the region.
Several customers already work with Danieli. However, substantial opportunities remain to deepen those relationships and expand our involvement far beyond our current level of business.
Your mission will be to transform existing awareness into trust, and trust into long-term partnerships, customer loyalty and sustainable business growth.
We are looking for someone who can become the person our customers call first when they need advice, support or a reliable partner.
The successful candidate will not operate as a stand-alone salesperson.
Commercial strategy, customer development plans and growth initiatives are defined in close coordination with the Danieli Group headquarters in Italy and the Nordic Area.
The role is fully integrated within a broader international organization and supported by dedicated technical, commercial and engineering resources worldwide.
Daily support is provided by the Nordic Area Manager, while customer visits and business development activities are frequently performed jointly with Product Line Managers, technical specialists and senior representatives from Danieli headquarters.
The objective is to combine local presence and relationship-building with the engineering expertise, product knowledge and global resources of the Danieli Group. We are therefore looking for a person who enjoys being on the front line with customers, while being fully supported by an international team behind them.
You are not expected to be a lone hunter searching for orders.
We are looking for someone who can walk into a plant, understand the challenges faced by its people, speak their language and ultimately become the person they trust when it is time to place an order.
In the Nordic industrial culture, trust is not a sales tool, It is the foundation upon which long-term business is built.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before the closing date. Interviews are conducted continuously throughout the recruitment process. Preferred start date is as soon as possible, but this is not a requirement.

About Antrino
Antrino Labs is building the platform that makes every square meter intelligent.
The physical world runs on processes nobody can actually see. Goods move, machines idle, space goes unused, and decisions about all of it are based on samples, guesses, and reports written after the fact. Antrino lets any organization deploy vision intelligence into a physical space and get back what is actually happening there, as structured, real-time information it can act on. Not a research project or a custom integration, but a platform where you describe what matters and deploy it.
We have grown from 6 people to a team of 28 in less than a year, closed our Seed round, announced together with Dagens Industri, and are registered with Inspektionen för strategiska produkter (ISP), the Swedish authority for strategic and dual-use products. The role
You will build the services that turn a customer's intent into working intelligence.
When a customer builds something in Studio, our composition canvas, that graph has to become a running system: a plan that decides which models to call, in what order, gated by cost and confidence, and that produces events and evidence a customer can trust. Backend services for detection, classification, and measurement, largely in Python with FastAPI
The compiler that turns a Studio graph into an execution plan, and the runtime that deploys and runs it
Routing logic that decides which model handles which work, including cost gating where a cheap model decides when an expensive one runs
The Agent's interview, graph-editing, and deployment flows that turn natural language into a working pipeline
Integrating our first-party detection models, and frontier model APIs where they do something ours do not yet, behind one clean interface
Turning raw model output into structured, auditable events and evidence an operator can trust
APIs and data models for streams, behaviors, runs, and events in PostgreSQL with row-level security
Tests and evaluation harnesses for logic that includes non-deterministic model calls
Debugging production issues that span a customer request, our orchestration, and the model call underneath

Our stack
You do not need experience with all of this, but you should recognize most of it and be able to argue about it.
Backend: Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, Node.jsData: PostgreSQL through Supabase, with row-level security, 
Streaming: RTSP ingestion, RTSP→HLS conversion, live and archive pipelines

Who we are looking for Substantial backend experience on production systems, ideally where an LLM or ML model was part of the core logic rather than a bolted-on feature
Strong Python, and comfort in TypeScript or Node.js
Real experience designing APIs, data models, and service boundaries, including PostgreSQL

An understanding of how to test systems with non-deterministic components

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral fellow in Structural studies of mitochondrial DNA replication
jobs.description:
This postdoctoral position is part of a research project funded by a Wallenberg Scholar grant. The postdoctoral researcher will work in an interdisciplinary team with expertise in molecular biology, biochemistry and structural biology. The project aims to understand the molecular mechanisms that govern mitochondrial DNA replication and gene expression, and how defects in these processes contribute to human disease.
 
Subject area 
Structural studies of mitochondrial DNA replication
 
Subject area description 
Mitochondrial DNA replication is essential for maintaining mtDNA integrity and stability and thereby for normal mitochondrial function and cellular energy production. Defects in the replication process can lead to mtDNA depletion or deletions and cause mitochondrial disease.
Our research aims to understand the molecular mechanisms that govern replication of human mtDNA. We combine structural biology, in vitro biochemistry and cell biology to investigate how the mitochondrial DNA replication machinery is organized and regulated. A particular focus is on structural and functional studies of the protein complexes involved in mtDNA replication and on understanding how disease-associated mutations affect these processes.
 
Job assignments
In this project, In this project, the postdoctoral researcher will carry out structural and functional studies of protein and protein-DNA complexes involved in mitochondrial DNA replication. A central aim will be to determine structures of replication complexes using single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) and use these structures to understand how the proteins interact and regulate mtDNA replication at the molecular level.
The work will include preparation and biochemical characterization of protein complexes, cryo-EM sample preparation and grid optimization, as well as processing and structural analysis of cryo-EM data. Structural findings will be combined with in vitro biochemical analyses to test mechanistic models and investigate how disease-associated mutations affect the function of the replication machinery.
The postdoctoral researcher is expected to drive the project independently while working closely with other members of the research group and our collaborators.
 
Eligibility 
The eligibility criteria for employing teaching staff are set out in Chapter 4 of the Higher Education Ordinance and in the Appointment Procedure for Teaching Posts at the University of Gothenburg.
To be eligible for appointment as a postdoc, the applicant is required to have a doctoral degree, a doctoral degree in art or a foreign degree that is deemed to be equivalent to a doctoral degree. This eligibility requirement must be met before the employment decision is made.
In the first instance, those who have completed their degree no more than three years prior to the end of the application period shall be considered. Those who have completed their degree more than three years prior to the end of the application period may also be considered in the first instance if special grounds exist. Special grounds relate to leave of absence due to illness, parental leave, commissions of trust within union organisations, service within the defence services or other similar circumstances, as well as clinical service or service/assignment relevant to the subject area. 
 
Assessment criteria 
We are seeking a highly motivated researcher with a doctoral degree in structural biology, biochemistry, molecular biology or a related field.
Documented experience in structural studies of proteins or macromolecular complexes using cryo-electron microscopy is required. Experience in protein purification and protein biochemistry is also required.
Experience in single-particle cryo-EM, including sample preparation, grid optimization, data processing and structural analysis, is particularly meritorious. Experience in structural studies of protein-DNA complexes is a strong advantage. Knowledge of mitochondrial systems and experience in cloning, mutagenesis, protein expression, cell culture and in vitro biochemical analyses are considered merits.
Great emphasis will be placed on scientific skills and the ability to independently plan, carry out and analyse research. The work involves close collaboration both within and outside the research group, making good teamwork and communication skills important. The candidate is expected to have strong scientific curiosity and the ability to work both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team.
Excellent spoken and written English is required, as the research group operates in an international environment.
 
Regulations for the evaluation of qualifications for academic positions are given in Chapter 4, Section 3 - 4 of the Higher Education Ordinance.
 
Employment 
The employment is full time and temporary, two years with the possibility of one year's extension, with placement at the Institute of Biomedicine. First day of employment as agreed.
